title: Director/founder/Advisor (Remote)
description: About The OpportunityA fast-scaling digital-first fashion brand in the D2C apparel sector, we’re reimagining everyday style for the modern Indian consumer through data-led design, hyper-personalized marketing, and agile supply chain innovation.
